jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Cloud & SaaS Integrations
jobs.description:
Location

Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
Working proficiency in SQL
Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

Experience building integration platforms or extensibility frameworks as a core part of a product
Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do'er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

Unlimited Vacation
Flexible Working Options
Health Insurance
Parental Leave
Employee Stock Option Plan
Home Office Allowance
Professional Development Stipend
Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team , where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.title: SharePoint Developer/Consultant
jobs.description:
About the company

Spanish Point Technologies is an innovative software company specializing in Microsoft technologies to provide business systems that streamline processes, enhance productivity, and facilitate access to critical business information. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, we offer consulting and solution building services using Microsoft's core information worker and related technologies. Our services encompass design, implementation, project management, training, and ongoing technical support.

Job Description

Working as a member of our Modern Workplace team, you will use your experience in architecture, development and consultancy in SharePoint and Microsoft 365 to deliver solutions and services, for our clients through the full Software Development Lifecycle.
You will be using the latest versions of Microsoft’s platform technologies for building these solutions. These technologies include SharePoint/Office365/PowerApps (canvas), Power Platform, .Net/C#, Azure. As part of this challenging role, you will use your existing skills in developing complex solutions and will have an opportunity to broaden your skills to other key Microsoft technologies including the above and more.
Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft Copilot Studio is highly desirable, as these technologies play an increasingly important role in designing and delivering modern workplace solutions that enhance collaboration, automation, and AI-powered productivity.
You will be exposed to all aspects of solution delivery including business analysis, architecture, development, and training of end users.

Job Requirements

3+ years’ SharePoint Online development or consultancy experience
Experience in customer-facing role including requirements-gathering,
hosting workshops and other forms of consultancy
Knowledge of canvas PowerApps development
Good communication skills and organisation skills
Experience in client-side web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and SPFx
Degree in Computer Science or equivalent

The following skills and experiences are also advantageous

Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Studio is highly desirable
Experience in PowerShell scripting particularly with respect to SharePoint
Experience in Dynamics 365 and PowerApps Platform (Dataverse)
Experience in modern web programming languages Typescript/React
Experience in Azure development i.e Azure Functions etc.
Experience in .Net, preferably using C#

Company Benefits

Ongoing training and support
Financial support for professional development
Annual performance reviews
24/7 Employee assistance
Health insurance
Life assurance
Cycle to Work scheme
Hybrid work environment
Sports & social activities
Free canteen
Referral bonus scheme

Please note: To be considered for this role, you must be an EU citizen and have full
working rights within the European Union.

Application Process

Please submit your application and CV via our website Careers page , or by emailing recruitment@spanishpoint.ie .
For any inquiries about the position or questions regarding the application process, you can contact recruitment@spanishpoint.ie .

Note: This job description is provided for informational purposes and may be subject to change.

jobs.title: Senior backendutvikler med C#/.NET-erfaring
jobs.description:
Har du solid erfaring med backend-utvikling på C#/.NET, liker å ta tekniske valg og trigges av å løse komplekse problemer i systemer som betyr mye for mange? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.
I Telenor bygger vi nye løsninger – men minst like viktig er jobben med å videreutvikle, forenkle og modernisere systemene som allerede er en viktig del av virksomheten vår. Du blir en del av et faglig sterkt miljø hvor du får mulighet til å påvirke både arkitektur, teknologi og hvordan vi jobber med modernisering fremover.

Du vil jobbe i et backend-miljø som forvalter og moderniserer løsninger med høy betydning for Telenors kunder, drift og interne prosesser. Det betyr at du både får jobbe med nyutvikling og med smarte forbedringer av systemer som allerede er i aktiv bruk.

Hva skal du jobbe med?

Som senior utvikler vil du jobbe hands-on med utvikling, samtidig som du får en viktig rolle i de tekniske diskusjonene i teamet.
Du vil blant annet få:
utvikle og videreutvikle løsninger basert på C# og .NET
bidra til modernisering av eksisterende systemer og tjenester
være med på å ta og dokumentere arkitekturbeslutninger
utfordre eksisterende løsninger og foreslå bedre og enklere måter å gjøre ting på
jobbe med databaser og datamodeller i MSSQL
utvikle og drifte løsninger på OpenShift
bidra til automatisering av deployment og moderne CI/CD-praksis
samarbeide tett med utviklere, tech leads og andre fagmiljøer i Telenor

Vi ønsker ikke bare noen som kan skrive god kode. Vi ser etter deg som også er nysgjerrig på hvorfor vi bygger ting slik vi gjør – og hvordan vi kan gjøre dem bedre.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har bred erfaring med systemutvikling og har stått i tekniske valg over tid. Rundt 10 års relevant erfaring kan være et godt utgangspunkt, men kvaliteten og bredden i erfaringen din er viktigere enn et bestemt antall år. Det er en fordel om du har jobbet i flere ulike selskaper eller teknologimiljøer. Da har du sannsynligvis sett at det finnes mer enn én måte å løse et problem på – og kanskje også erfart hvilke løsninger man helst ikke bør gjenta. Som en bonus må du gjerne kunne litt, eller ha lyst til å lære, Typescript/React frontend, men det er ikke et krav til stillingen.

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du:

har solid erfaring med C# og .NET
har erfaring med MSSQL
er komfortabel med å delta i og drive frem arkitektur- og teknologibeslutninger
kjenner moderne prinsipper for softwareutvikling og systemarkitektur
har erfaring med containerbaserte plattformer, gjerne OpenShift
er interessert i modernisering, refaktorering og gradvis forbedring av eksisterende systemer
evner å balansere teknisk kvalitet, kompleksitet og forretningsbehov
liker å dele kunnskap og diskutere løsninger med andre

Har du i tillegg erfaring med ArgoCD og GitOps, er det et klart pluss.

Vi ønsker utviklere som tør å stille spørsmål, utfordre etablerte sannheter og bidra til at vi hele tiden blir litt bedre. Du trenger ikke komme inn døren med alle svarene, men vi håper du kommer inn med erfaring, nysgjerrighet og lysten til å finne dem sammen med oss.

Mer om teamet og løsningene våre

Du blir en del av TFS-teamet - Technical Field Services. Vi utvikler digitale arbeidsverktøy for teknikere og entreprenører som bygger, drifter og vedlikeholder Telenors nett. Løsningene våre gjør det mulig å utføre flere oppgaver selvbetjent ute i felt og knytter sammen app, web og backend med sentrale arbeidsordre-, nettverks- og leveransesystemer. Teamet er tverrfaglig og består av backend-, frontend- og fullstackutviklere, design, test, produktledelse og tech lead. Vi arbeider sammen fra innsikt og brukerbehov til arkitektur, utvikling, produksjonssetting og drift.
Det vi bygger har målbar effekt. TFS brukes blant annet til selvbetjent arbeid på mobilsite, digital skaderapportering og enklere aktivering av kundeutstyr. Resultatet er mindre manuelt arbeid, raskere feilretting, bedre datakvalitet og kortere vei fra hendelse til handling.
Som senior backend-utvikler vil du arbeide med domenemodeller, API-er, integrasjoner, dataflyt og robuste tjenester i et komplekst systemlandskap. Du får både modernisere løsninger med lang historie og være med på å utvikle nye kapabiliteter for fremtidens arbeid i felt.

Modernisering er mer enn å bytte teknologi

Noe av det mest spennende med rollen er at du kommer inn i et miljø hvor løsningene allerede har en historie. Her handler modernisering ikke om å kaste alt og begynne på nytt. Det handler derimot om å forstå hvorfor systemene ser ut som de gjør, finne ut hva som fortsatt fungerer godt, identifisere hva som bør endres og gjennomføre forbedringene på en trygg og bærekraftig måte. Det krever både teknisk erfaring, nysgjerrighet og en god porsjon pragmatisme.
Og det er nettopp den kombinasjonen vi ser etter.

Praktisk informasjon
